name: write_file
description: Write content to a file, replacing its entire contents (no append, no merge). Returns the absolute path on success. temp=false (default) accepts an absolute path or a path relative to the effective working directory (parent dirs created); temp=true writes a relative filename under the per-session temp dir, cleaned up at session end. For modifying an existing file, prefer apply_patch.

file_path.description: Path to the file to write: absolute or relative to the effective working directory when temp=false; relative filename when temp=true (absolute paths are rejected).

content.description: Full file content to write (overwrites existing file).

temp.description: When true, write under the per-session temp directory; use for scratch/intermediate files (scripts, data dumps, test fixtures). Temp files are cleaned up when the session ends. (default: false)
